deviations.description: Implement the two mandatory ineligibility rules
deviations.reason: A third, unstated ineligibility rule was required: an absolute (/-leading) path containing no .claude/ substring also returns nil. Without it, the fixture example '/opt/mytools/my-custom-hook.sh' (required to be null) would become identity-eligible under the two literally-stated rules alone, which would make the sweep unsafe for a hand-written absolute-path hook -- the single most dangerous regression this task names. Documented at length in hook_identity.lua's doc comment.
